item.summary: fix(skills): strengthen authoring guidance and accept invocation frontmatter (#121955) Rewrite the bundled skill-creator SKILL.md workflow-first with checkable completion criteria, tighten the runtime skill-authoring standards prompt, dedupe keep/drop policy out of the collection-only skill_workshop tool description (collection-review.ts remains the sole owner), and teach quick_validate.py the documented invocation frontmatter keys (disable-model-invocation, command-dispatch, command-tool, command-arg-mode) it previously rejected. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
